# Michael Lynch — portfolio

> Personal site of Michael Lynch (BEng, PhD), a product leader in Toronto working on AI in healthcare.

## Sections

* [Home](index.html) — hero, positioning, primary calls to action.
* [About](index.html#about) — background, career through-line, how to get in touch.
* [Focus](index.html#focus) — three areas of current work: cooperative agents, clinical data interfaces, product at scale.
* [Work](index.html#projects) — eight projects across open source, research, and health-system product work.
* [Elsewhere](index.html#elsewhere) — links to Google Scholar, GitHub, Medium, LinkedIn, and Calendly.

## Selected projects

* **The Healthcare Agents Collective** — multi-agent A2A system for clinical care.
* **MCP Server for FHIR** — query FHIR servers in natural language.
* **ReferWell** — open-source patient referral coordination.
* **HospitalGPT** — AI agents managing simulated patient populations.
* **FibrosisNet / COVIDNet** — medical imaging research (DarwinAI).
* **Privata.ai & Patient Data Network** — co-founded startup, internal breach detection.
* **AI products at Providence** — AI product initiatives across a large health system.
* **OpenMRS Java SDK** — EMR integration for the Privata.ai platform.
